title: unified-rollouts: add rollback observability + e2e stability tests for canary/AB/shadow flows
author: Lina Chen
release_notes: Add observability hooks and dashboards for autorollback triggers; include e2e stability tests for canary/A-B/shadow rollout flows and fix flaky rollback edge-cases.
description:
Motivation: customers rely on automatic rollback during canary/A-B/shadow rollouts, but debugging why a rollback happened is often hard. This PR adds structured observability for rollback triggers, expands metric tagging, and introduces a deterministic e2e test suite that simulates common failure modes to prevent regressions.

What changed (high level):
- Emit a new set of rollback-related metrics and events (rollback.trigger_reason, rollback.metric_values, rollback.quorum_state) with standardized tags (customer_id, deployment_id, rollout_stage, metric_name).
- Surface rollback decision traces in the rollout trace/span with linkable IDs so Console can show the causal chain (policy evaluation -> metric window -> decision).
- Add metric-matching debug logs that are gated by a rollout debug flag to avoid high-cardinality in prod.
- Fix an edge-case in the autorollback engine where metrics with sparse reporting could cause inconsistent quorum evaluation under multi-metric policies.
- Add an e2e test harness that runs canary, A/B, and shadow flows against a local simulator to validate: detection of regressions, correct quorum semantics, and no false-positive rollbacks during transient spikes.
- Add documentation snippets and a new dashboard template in observability-pack for rollback events.

Testing and CI:
- Unit tests added for autorollback quorum logic and for metric tagging.
- Integration tests for rollout trace propagation.
- New e2e tests (deterministic simulator) added to perf-canary/e2e that run under CI stage "rollouts-e2e"; they run in ~6 minutes.
- Addressed a flaky test in rollout_scheduler by tightening timeouts and adding stability guards.

Checklist: 
- [x] Metrics emission implemented and documented
- [x] Trace/span linkage added
- [x] Autorollback bugfix and unit tests
- [x] End-to-end deterministic tests for canary/AB/shadow
- [x] Dashboard template in observability-pack
- [x] Reviewed and approved by infra and observability teams

Notes: This PR touches runtime decision paths; changes are backwards-compatible (metrics/traces are additive) and rollout policies default behavior is unchanged unless "enable_rollback_debug" is toggled. See release_notes for UI/docs updates.
